headline: Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash jumps 10 spots to No. 13 and sets an all-time share record at 1.6%
summary: Baidu's ERNIE 5.5 Flash is the day's headline, climbing 10 places and hitting an all-time token share high of 1.6% for a second day running. Meanwhile, the newcomer Gemma 4 31B and the departing Claude Sonnet 5 both sit down at the bottom of the table, at about 0.2% each.
highlights: baidu/ernie-5.5-flash-preview-20261110:free jumped 10 places to No. 13 and set an all-time token share record of 1.6%, now on day 2 of that streak.
New entrant google/gemma-4-31b-it-20260402 debuts at No. 49 with 0.2% share.
anthropic/claude-sonnet-5-20260630 dropped out of the rankings from No. 51 with 0.2% share.
DeepSeek still holds the top spot: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 leads at 28.3%, and DeepSeek as a provider holds 38.7%.
The top three providers, DeepSeek, Tencent and OpenAI, hold 55.5% of token share between them.
